testing.title: Symfony Panther: writing tests
testing.description: Symfony Panther tests: PantherTestCase, client API, crawler, interactions, waitFor mechanics, screenshots. Use when writing a Symfony Panther browser test.
testing.intro: Panther drives a real browser through the familiar BrowserKit API. waitFor* is what makes a JavaScript-heavy page testable.

setup.title: Symfony Panther: setup and CI
setup.description: Symfony Panther setup: ChromeDriver and GeckoDriver, all PANTHER_* variables, Selenium, Docker and CI. Use when configuring Panther or running it in CI.
setup.intro: Most Panther problems are environment problems. The PANTHER_* variables control everything from headless mode to window size.
